HEIC orientation fixtures are intentionally not committed yet.

Add small files using this naming scheme:

    orientation_<orientation>_want_<width>x<height>.heic

For example, a 3x2 HEIC with orientation 6 that should become upright as
2x3 after AutoRotate, Strip, and JPEG export should be named:

    orientation_6_want_2x3.heic

Use fixtures that are safe to redistribute, and note their source/license here.
